SRC-279:R001.text: SAIHANDOFF T-301 live input acceptance and readable reporting: the receipt body is a single title line, so the only derivable requirement is that T-301 (whatever it turns out to be) demonstrate live input acceptance and produce readable reporting. No handoff document, acceptance criteria, target system, or failure description accompanies it on this machine.
SRC-279:R001.verification: Read-only real SAITULS BOARD still blocks T-301 on real vendor acceptance and has existing approval-dependent T-302; local rendering proof does not satisfy unconditional live input acceptance. Original R001 text and provenance preserved.

SRC-279:R002.text: Regression A: a raw multiline response remains multiline once delivered to a Markdown host -- every line a field occupies must be a CommonMark hard break (two spaces before the newline), because a bare newline inside a paragraph run is a soft break that joins the lines with a space.
SRC-279:R002.verification: Native seven-test same-oracle regression and actual installed Markdown component prove canonical field hard breaks; current response suite passes.

SRC-279:R003.text: Regression B: structured result fields are not concatenated -- each canonical field keeps its own line and its own LABEL: prefix when the reply is rendered, and the number of visible lines equals the number of fields emitted.
SRC-279:R003.verification: Current 158-test response selection and the seven-test renderer oracle retain each canonical label on its own line.

SRC-279:R004.text: Regression C: the canonical response checks still pass on the readable form -- render_boundary output validates with response_errors returning no errors, stays within its declared visible-line and character budget, and the existing response suites (contract, digest, delivery, fact binding, chat style, hush runtime) stay green.
SRC-279:R004.verification: All seven response patterns pass 158 tests under the bound native runtime; response checker, budgets, fact binding, delivery, chat style and hush remain enforced.

SRC-279:R005.text: Regression L: technical detail is preserved in durable evidence and not dumped into the operator-facing reply -- the surface carries only O(1) counts/categories and at most one reference line; a multi-line DETAILS value is hard-broken like every other line rather than collapsed.
SRC-279:R005.verification: Current renderer tests retain bounded summaries and durable evidence pointers, including internal multiline field hard breaks; no details-budget waiver.
